elements.description: A voice conversation: the orb, live captions for every turn, and Mute, Captions, Interrupt and End.

properties.name: state
properties.description: What the assistant is doing: idle · listening · thinking · speaking

properties.name: turns
properties.description: The conversation so far, oldest first. A turn still coming in has `partial` set

properties.name: level
properties.description: Input or output loudness from 0 to 1, for the orb – unset, the orb fakes a natural level

properties.name: muted
properties.description: The microphone is muted. Changed by the element unless a tc-muted-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: captions
properties.description: The captions are shown. Changed by the element unless a tc-captions-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: heading
properties.description: A title over the orb – unset, there's none

properties.name: name
properties.description: The assistant's name on its turns and in what screen readers hear

properties.name: userName
properties.description: The person's name on their turns

properties.name: placeholder
properties.default: "Start talking – your words show up here."
properties.description: Shown while there are no turns yet

properties.name: labels
properties.description: The line under the orb, per state and while muted

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-muted-change
events.description: Mute was switched (`{ muted: boolean }`); cancelable – prevent it to keep `muted` (controlled use)

events.name: tc-captions-change
events.description: Captions were shown or hidden (`{ captions: boolean }`); cancelable

events.name: tc-interrupt
events.description: Interrupt was pressed (or Esc) while the assistant thinks or speaks; detail: null

props.name: muted
props.description: The microphone is muted (controlled when defined)

props.name: defaultMuted
props.description: Whether the microphone starts muted, when `muted` isn't set

props.name: onMutedChange
props.description: Called when Mute is pressed, with the new muted state

props.name: captions
props.description: The captions are shown (controlled when defined)

props.name: defaultCaptions
props.description: Whether the captions start shown, when `captions` isn't set – true by default

props.name: onCaptionsChange
props.description: Called when Captions is pressed, with whether they are now shown

props.name: onInterrupt
props.description: Interrupt was pressed (or Esc) while the assistant thinks or speaks

changelog: `tc-voice-mode` – a voice conversation: `tc-voice-orb` for the state, live captions that announce finished turns once, and Mute / Captions / Interrupt / End in a toolbar; Esc interrupts. The audio stays the app's.
